Letting agent fees: compare the total, not the headline

A single percentage rarely tells you what a year of management will cost. Here is the structure we think every landlord should compare, with GETLET's own figures provided as a written quotation.

The fee structure

GETLET provides a written quotation for every property, itemising each line below and stating whether VAT is included.

ChargeWhat it isHow GETLET provides it
Management chargeThe ongoing fee for managing the property, usually a percentage of rent or a fixed monthly amount. Check whether it applies to rent due or rent collected.Itemised in your written quotation, including VAT. The quotation states whether it applies to rent due or rent collected.
Tenant-find or letting chargeThe one-off fee for advertising the property and finding a tenant.Itemised in your written quotation, including VAT.
SetupAny fee for onboarding the property or preparing the agreement.Itemised in your written quotation, including VAT.
InspectionsWhether property inspections are included, and the price of extra visits.Itemised in your written quotation, including VAT.
Compliance arrangementThe cost of arranging gas, electrical and EPC work. The certificate itself is a separate cost from a partner agency.Itemised in your written quotation, including VAT.
Repair arrangement or administrationWhether repair invoices are passed on at cost or carry an arrangement fee.Itemised in your written quotation, including VAT.
Renewal and rent reviewAny charge for renewing a tenancy, reviewing the rent or varying terms.Itemised in your written quotation, including VAT.
Major worksHow larger projects are authorised and whether a supervision fee applies.Itemised in your written quotation, including VAT.
Exit or cancellation termsNotice periods and any charge for ending the agreement.Itemised in your written quotation, including VAT.
VAT treatmentWhether quoted prices include VAT.Itemised in your written quotation, including VAT.

Before you sign

What to ask any agent before you sign

These questions apply to GETLET and to every other agent you speak to. Ask for the answers in writing.

  • What is the total cost over the first 12 months, including VAT?
  • Is the management charge based on rent due or rent collected?
  • Are there setup, inspection, renewal or rent review fees?
  • Who pays for gas, electrical and EPC work, and who arranges it?
  • Are repair invoices passed on at cost, or is there an arrangement fee?
  • How are major works authorised, and is there a spending limit?
  • What happens to my money if the agent stops trading? Which client money protection scheme are they in?
  • Which redress scheme can I use if something goes wrong?
  • How long is the contract, and what does it cost to leave?
  • Who is my named contact, and how will I be updated?

Want the numbers in writing?
